question.text: Unit transfer in secondary market by investor triggers stamp duty of:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 9.6, stamp duty on transfer of AIF units is 0.015% (charged per Indian Stamp Act 1899 post-Finance Act 2019). **The Trap:** Other rates don't apply to AIF unit transfer. **Cross-Exam Context:** Tested in Topic 3 too. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Include this in secondary-market unit transfer cost modeling.
